books.label: Book One of the Realmfire Series
books.title: The Burning of the Realm
books.description:
Tired of the same old tropes in fantasy books? Well, you’re in luck.

Meet Page, a burned-out millennial healthcare worker who steps out into traffic intending to end it all.

Too bad he wakes up in a fae realm instead.

Pulled through a portal by Shaylee, an ancient fae living on an isolated island with her giant pet rabbit. Yes, you read that right.

In order to open another portal to their own realms, they must learn to tolerate each other while navigating their new reality. Somewhere along the way, Page and Shaylee must confront a question they never expected:

How do you keep living when all you wanted to do was disappear?

Grab some tissues, and drink some water.

*The Burning of the Realm* is the first novel in the Realmfire Series blending humor, healing, and mythology into one fantasy adventure.

books.label: Book Two of the Realmfire Series Coming Early 2027
books.title: The Burned Legacy
books.description:
After stepping into traffic trying to end it all, Page, a burned-out millennial healthcare worker, found himself choosing to stay in the fae realm with Shaylee and her giant, judgmental rabbit named Henry.

﻿﻿Choosing to stay was the easy part. It’s what comes next that is the real challenge. What did you expect, a happily ever after? Seriously, after *that* ending?

Page and Shaylee must now face a realm in chaos following the events in Rehmani, and the problem with the portal didn’t magically disappear.

It only got bigger.

Portals, old gods, witches, and realm-wide conflicts will all collide, leaving the duo with the ultimate question:

What is worth surviving for?

You know the drill: Grab some tissues and drink some water.

*The Burned Legacy* is the second novel in the Realmfire Series blending humor, healing, and mythology into one fantasy adventure.
